verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a ZeroTrace Mode that, when enabled, stops it from storing search parameters, files, or data, so users can opt out of search-data retention. By default, though, searches are cached and kept in a Searches Archive. Nothing in the evidence covers telemetry or analytics in the SDKs or MCP server, and the plan availability of ZeroTrace is unclear. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out controls, ZeroTrace setup and plan-availability details, SDK/MCP telemetry disclosure, independent corroboration.
